```{r}
#| results: asis
inference <- data.table(
 Item=c('Sample and units','Intervals','Plausible-value pooling','Multiplicity','System means','Validation'),
 Specification=c(
 '67 SES systems; 62 deprivation systems; all 6 skills. SES: reading points per 10 national percentile-rank points. Deprivation: points per additional unaffordable item, controlling parental education and occupation at pupil and school levels.',
 '499 whole-school bootstrap draws and 10 reading plausible values; individual 95 percent intervals. The cluster bootstrap approximates the survey design and does not implement the full stratified 2-stage BRR procedure.',
 'Pooled variance = mean within-plausible-value bootstrap variance + 1.1 times the variance of the 10 point estimates. Rank and skill standardization remain fixed at their prepared values.',
 'Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate target: 5 percent. Separate families by exposure: within/between skill gradients; individual skill contributions; joint pathway plus sorting increment; counterfactual gap reductions. Reading coefficients have no adjusted q-values.',
 'Equal-weight averages of country estimates. Mean variance is the sum of country variances divided by the squared number of systems, conditional on the retained system set.',
 'Custom R estimates checked against WeMix 4.0.3. Maximum fixed-coefficient discrepancy in 10 additional deprivation cases: 0.00000432. The matched-control comparison produced 499 valid paired draws per country; counterfactual prediction discrepancies were below 0.000001.'))
tbl(inference,'Estimation and reporting conventions for the appendix. These conventions apply unless a caption specifies otherwise.',8,widths=c('3cm','12cm'))
```

 Items=c('ST307: Q01, Q02, Q03, Q07, Q09, Q10 (JA); p. 74','ST301: Q01, Q04, Q06, Q08, Q10 (JA); p. 75','ST435: Q01, Q03, Q04, Q05 (DA); p. 76','ST216: Q01, Q03, Q04, Q05 (HA); p. 77','ST432: Q02, Q03, Q04, Q06 (DA); p. 78','ST434: Q01, Q02, Q04, Q06 (DA); p. 79'),
 Responses=c('5 agreement categories; Q07 and Q10 worded negatively.','5 agreement categories; Q08 worded negatively.','4 agreement categories.','5 self-description categories, from very much to not at all like me.','4 frequency categories, from never/almost never to very often.','4 agreement categories, listed from strongly agree to strongly disagree.'))

![Between-school skill gradients and reading relationships in all 67 6-skill systems. Dashed curves mark products of 1, 3, and 5 reading points, from lower to higher curves. Equal products can arise from different combinations of the 2 links. Black diamonds show equal-weight means of the 2 links. Their product is not the mean pathway. These are point estimates, not tests of cross-country differences.](../04_output/rev2/figures/ses_gap_link_b.pdf){width=100% fig-pos='H'}

  `Recipient change`=fmt(cfest(cc,'recipient_change',ex)),
  `Reference change`=fmt(cfest(cc,'reference_change',ex)),

 yy<-rbindlist(lapply(ids,function(cc)data.table(System=G[CNT==cc,economy],
  `Within component`=fmt(cfest(cc,'within_component',ex)),
  `Between component`=fmt(cfest(cc,'between_component',ex)),
  `Gap reduction percent [95% CI]`=cfshare(cc,ex))))
 print(tbl(yy,paste0(ex,': components of the gap reduction and its share of the observed group gap. Components use the same recipient assignment; they are not separate interventions. }

![Country-specific joint deprivation pathways in the 62 full-6-skill systems. Negative values indicate a reading penalty transmitted through skills per additional unaffordable item, accounting for individual and school parental education and occupational status. Brackets after system names give the retained item count; equal counts can still represent different item sets. The single mean row uses equal country weights. Bars are individual 95% bootstrap/PV intervals; shapes mark unadjusted 2-sided p-value bands as shown in the legend.](../04_output/rev2/figures/dep_pathways.pdf){#fig-dep width=100% fig-pos='H'}

![Skill-specific contributions to the deprivation pathway. Persev. denotes perseverance; Adapt., cognitive adaptability; Goals, goal setting; Problem solving, enjoyment of problem solving; and Help seeking, self-regulated help seeking. Values are reading points per additional unaffordable item, including the school sorting component. White circles denote p < 0.05 and triangles p < 0.10; unmarked cells are not significant (unadjusted, 2-sided). Symbols indicate the strongest threshold met; not significant refers to the 10% level.](../04_output/rev2/figures/dep_skills.pdf){#fig-dep-skills width=100% fig-pos='H'}

```{r}
#| results: asis
for(tt in c('skills_sorting','gap_reduction')) {
 x<-PCOMP[term==tt][order(economy)]
 bound<-function(v)ifelse(abs(v)>0&abs(v)<.005,fmt(v,4),fmt(v))
 f<-function(a,l,u)paste0(fmt(a),' [',bound(l),', ',bound(u),']')
 y<-x[,.(System=economy,`ESCS: same pupils`=f(escs,escs_lower,escs_upper),`Parental: preferred`=f(parental,parental_lower,parental_upper),`Paired change`=f(change,change_lower,change_upper),`Change q`=fmt(change_q,4))]
 print(tbl(y,paste0(if(tt=='skills_sorting')'Joint deprivation mediation' else 'Deprivation gap reduction',': reading points with 95 percent intervals. Change = parental minus ESCS on identical pupils; q uses the paired-change test family.'),7.3,widths=c('3cm','3.4cm','3.4cm','3.4cm','1.2cm')))
}
```
